mostWorthwhile.text: Making messenger RNA was most worthwhile: the working-copy explanation clearly connected the gene in the nucleus to protein production at the ribosome.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate channel and pump fittings felt repetitive because neither result added an explanation of how it worked.

surprise.text: The bilayer explanation clarified how water-facing heads and sheltered tails create a boundary.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the separate placements at the polymerase and ribosome felt procedural.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter to see how the cell's exchange and protein-making abilities contribute to tissues and body systems, though I would hope for more explanation alongside the fittings.
